msg: Hi, my daughter is 15 and has her PADI Junior Open Water, and I'm a Rescue Diver. We're from the US and we'd like to dive together one day from Cartagena in July. Can she dive with me, and what would it cost us?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a lovely day on the reef! Yes, your daughter can join the certified divers’ trip: the minimum age is 10, and she has her Junior Open Water certification. The one-day option from Cartagena is the two-dive Fun Dives trip. It visits two different dive sites, and each dive lasts 40–50 minutes.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 287 USD · 319 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD

I’m leaving the price per person below. Would you like to continue with the online booking?

msg: Yes, the two-dive trip, for both of us on July 12th. Could you send me the link? Do we each need to bring anything or fill out a form? She's a minor, is that a problem?
reply:
The two-dive trip from Cartagena is *$178 USD per person online*. Here’s the booking link: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

At 15, your daughter can join certified fun dives as long as she holds an Open Water certification, and minors must be accompanied by a demonstrable parent or responsible relative. Please bring your certification cards; you can show them on the day. Diving gear is included. Bring swimsuits, towels, sunscreen, sunglasses, and comfortable clothes.

You’ll each need to complete the insurance form sent in the booking confirmation email. Each diver also needs a liability waiver; the certified-diver waiver is here (the form is in Spanish): https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Is the other person diving too? 🤿
